claim: The demo loads sample data separately from a real card and can be reset.
sandbox: Fresh browser context opens /demo, edits and resets the sample, edits again, leaves for an empty real card, and confirms the demo edit was discarded.

claim: Health records stay in the browser during normal use.
where: Home privacy fact, footer, Privacy page, README
sandbox: Fresh /demo flow records every request while an example medicine is edited; all requests are same-origin.

claim: The card works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: Fresh browser context opens /demo once, waits for the active service worker, goes offline, and reloads the sample card.

claim: A plain JSON backup can be downloaded and restored.
sandbox: Fresh /demo flow downloads JSON, uploads a valid backup, accepts the replacement confirmation, and observes restored data.

claim: The current list appears on a one-page print/PDF handoff card.
sandbox: Fresh /demo flow generates an A4 PDF, asserts it has exactly one page, and checks the sample medicine and safety note.

claim: Keyboard Tab focus stays inside an open medicine dialog.
sandbox: Fresh /demo flow opens a medicine editor, tabs forward through all controls, reverse-tabs once, and asserts focus remains in the dialog.

claim: A verified one-time license enables a passphrase-protected backup.
sandbox: Fresh /demo flow stubs a valid Sociobot license response, downloads the encrypted backup, and asserts its encrypted format does not expose a sample medicine.

claim: The card records medicine details, confirmations, and dated change history across reloads.
sandbox: Fresh real card adds and edits a medicine, confirms it, reloads, and checks the current record and visible history.

claim: The interface supports light and dark themes, reduced motion, and a 390 px layout.
sandbox: Fresh 390 px demo changes theme, emulates reduced motion, measures transition duration, and checks horizontal fit.

claim: Encrypted backups cost $12 once through Sociobot checkout.
where: Home facts, paid section, Backup & settings, Terms, README
sandbox: Fresh home page checks the exact price and confirms the production Sociobot endpoint redirects to a Dodo checkout session.

claim: The card, print view, and plain JSON backup are free; encrypted backups cost $12 once.
where: Landing facts, paid section, Terms, README
sandbox: Fresh demo without a license enables Print / PDF and JSON download, while encrypted backup remains locked behind the visible $12 one-time checkout link.

claim: This communication record does not check interactions or recommend doses.
where: Landing safety note, empty state, Terms, README, print card
sandbox: Fresh demo inspects the record-only medicine editor and print safety note, and confirms no interaction-check or dose-recommendation action is presented.

claim: There is no health-data account or cloud copy.
where: Landing privacy section, Privacy page, README
sandbox: Fresh demo edit records outgoing requests and asserts only same-origin app assets are used; the visible product exposes no sign-in, account, or sync action.

claim: Downloaded plain JSON backups can be opened as text.
sandbox: Fresh demo downloads JSON and parses the downloaded text to assert its named owner and medicine are readable without a passphrase.
